title: S and E
summary: Two new keys: S and E. The finger goes out, presses, and comes back.
intro: Two new keys in this lesson: S and E. They belong to your left middle finger and your right middle finger. The movement is always the same — out, press, back — and the way back is the part being trained, because a finger left out of place spoils the next letter.
congrats: Two more keys under your fingers. If S and E already come without searching, the lesson has done its job.

screens.text: This key belongs to your left middle finger. Find it without looking, press it once, and let the finger return. The way back matters as much as the press.
Only S and what you already know. Slowly, and bring the finger back to the home row after every press.

screens.text: This key belongs to your right middle finger. Find it without looking, press it once, and let the finger return. The way back matters as much as the press.
Only E and what you already know. Slowly, and bring the finger back to the home row after every press.

sese eses

screens.text: Short groups, one after another. Keep going to the end even if you miss one.
The new keys mixed with the old ones, which is how they will turn up inside words.
